description: Run a ruleset against fixture documents with expectations — codes that must fire, exact counts, or a clean lint — and report pass/fail per case plus which rules no case asserts on or ever triggers.

cases.description: Fixtures: [{ name, document, expect }] where `expect` is a list of rule codes that must fire, a { code: count } map, or [] for a clean lint. Optional `forbid`: codes that must not fire.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on the task you are doing. Never used to answer or rank; read only if a result is reported wrong.

ruleset.description: A Spectral ruleset to run instead of the catalog default. Score against rules you never adopted means little — pass your own.

name: test_ruleset
